wallet.onboardingWaysTitle: {count} experiences to <vibra>generate income</vibra> by getting closer to your audience
wallet.onboardingCommunityPublicDesc: Open to the world. Anyone can discover it, join without approval, and see your content — even without a Vibra account. It's your showcase to grow, gain followers, and get known. Ideal to start and build an audience.
wallet.onboardingCommunityPublicNote: Being open, you won't be able to enable subscriptions.
wallet.onboardingCommunityPrivateDesc: Visible but exclusive. It appears in search so people can find you, but your content is members-only. You decide who gets in and can charge a monthly subscription. Perfect for turning followers into a community that supports you every month.
wallet.onboardingCommunityPrivateNote: In this type of community you can enable a subscription.
wallet.onboardingCommunityHiddenDesc: Your most intimate circle. It doesn't appear in any search and can only be joined with your invite link. From the outside no one sees anything; only your members know this community exists. The ideal space for your most exclusive content and a monthly subscription with the people you truly want close.
wallet.onboardingCommunityHiddenNote: In this type of community you can enable a subscription.
wallet.onboardingCloseText: Turning on your experiences is completely free, you pay nothing to enable them and there are no setup costs. Switch on the ones you want, turn them off whenever you want, and experiment at your own pace. You're in control of everything.
wallet.onboardingSvc1Desc: Make your followers feel special with a video recorded just for them, whether for a birthday, a celebration or any important moment.
wallet.onboardingSvc2Desc: Answer your followers' questions on video and share advice tailored to their situation.
wallet.onboardingSvc3Desc: Share a private, unhurried broadcast with a follower. You decide how long it lasts, up to 90 minutes.
wallet.onboardingSvc4Desc: Connect face to face with your followers in a private broadcast of 5 to 25 minutes.
wallet.onboardingSvc5Desc: Let your viewers highlight their messages during your live streams to get your attention and support your content.
wallet.onboardingSvc6Desc: Let your audience show their support with voluntary contributions while you're streaming live.

wallet.onboardingSvc8Desc: Create a special community for your closest followers and share exclusive content and perks with them every month.
wallet.onboardingSvc9Desc: Host exclusive live streams and let your followers buy access to join you live.
